Westwind stood up, stepped closer to the camera, and filled the screen with her round cheeks.

"A battle-damaged battlecruiser that had been sitting around for ages was recently sent to the shipbreaking yard... It would have been a shame to scrap such an old veteran, so... Westwind refurbished it without telling anyone..."

Westwind takes a few steps back, revealing her petite figure and winter outfit in full.
options:
TDB_Important_talk2:"Quite a story. So what happened next?"
TDB_Important_talk3:"Does nobody check your expense accounts?"

text:
Westwind blinks and continues her train of thought.

"...Right! There is no place for the ship in the current order of battle... so Westwind will give it to $playerName...?"

She taps her thick-soled sandals against the floor with a solid thud.

"Of course... it is not free...? How about doing something for Westwind first, as a kind of exchange...?"
options: TDB_Important_start:"Go on. I want to hear the details before I decide."

text:
Westwind freezes for two seconds, apparently choosing her words.

"Do not worry... no public funds were misappropriated, okay? It was all private money used for private purposes..."

"Anyway, anyway... about the ship $playerName might want... How about doing one small job for Westwind? Think of the ship as a keepsake prepared for $playerName to remember our partnership by..."
options: TDB_Important_start:"Go on. I want to hear the details before I decide."

text:
"...Caution is a fine virtue... Westwind can tell $playerName what the job involves... $playerName can decide after hearing everything...?"

Westwind closes her eyes and shakes her head, making her long hair and antlers sway. When she opens them again, her gaze seems clearer.

"...The job is to salvage a confidential archive from Kanta's Den... A fleet sent there for a technical exchange with Tri-Tachyon was ambushed by pirates a few days ago... The pirate fleet was much larger than expected. Mm... but with such an extensive debris field, their salvage technology should not be able to locate the archive anytime soon...? They should still be salvaging at the site; wait too long and they will recover it..."

"...Recover the confidential archive... and bring it back to Westwind...?"

text:
Early on, the Bureau had cooperated with Loulan Industries, we had exchanged the blueprints of the "Rain Curtain class" for those of the "Wave class", and engineers from both side had successfully modified the exchanged prototypes according to their respective fleet doctrines - it should have been a perfect cooperation.
Unfortuantely, due to a subsequent change in Loulan's stance, the Bureau had broken off diplomatic relations with them. and by nowdays, outright hostility.

$personName sighs and takes a sip of the unknown beverage in the drinking glass, seemingly lamenting the loss of an ally and the rising of a new enemy.

"Blue Sea Fisheries? They have great instant noodles. cough.."

$personName cleared her throat and her eyes involuntarily drifted to the side, as if embarrased for accidentally saying something out of place.

"Hmm... They've been allies with us for a long time now, and while they don't provide help on the front lines, they cooperate quite a bit with the Bureau in terms of supplies, scientific research, and the like."

"Speaking of which, I must mention the "Stratocumulus" Class Ships produced by the Design Bureau despite its unassuming look, the internal systems and layout have been completely redesigned by the Bureau, even the designers on the Blue Sea side are full of praise."

$personName seems a little excited at the topic of the conversation, staring at you intently.

"If there is any interest, We can sell you at factory price. Of course, it will have to be when the production line have production room to spare for it."
